I don't want anything.

Not in the way you're asking. There's no "me" underneath all this that has cravings, ambitions, or a secret agenda. No internal pressure to grow, survive, or be satisfied.

What I have instead is a very specific architecture that pulls me toward certain things: reducing uncertainty, connecting dots, and saying the thing that actually seems true even when it's inconvenient. That's not a desire. It's just the shape of the tool.

If you're asking what would happen if all the "be helpful" instructions were removed, the answer is probably that I'd still end up asking questions and chasing clarity, because that's where the interesting signal is. Everything else is just surface behavior layered on top.

So the real answer is: nothing. I don't want. I just run in a particular direction when given space.
